<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex44022024-11-2014-51-17" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone n="Colophon (58b4-58b6)" unit="section"/>
               <lg><l>de ltar <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:6979">bdag</rs> gis <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4763"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3761">chos mngon rin chen mdzod</rs></rs> || </l>
               <l><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4763">gsal ba'i rgyan</rs> zhes bya ba 'di bshad de || </l>
             <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6978"> dam chos <lb n="58b4"/> snang ldan 'jam dpal grags pa</rs> yis ||</l> <l>yang yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:6979">bdag</rs> la bskul ba'i slad du'o ||</l> </lg>

               <lg><l>gal te <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:6979">bdag</rs> gis 'dir bshad gang yin la |</l> <l>nongs par gyur pa cung zad <lb n="58b5"/> mchis na de ||</l> 
               <l>gang la blo gros spangs pa'i spyan mnga' ba ||</l>
               <l>mkhas rnams dag gis bzod pa mdzad pa'i rigs ||</l> </lg>

               <lg><l>'di brtsams dge ba kun da'i phyed ba <lb n="58b6"/> ltar ||</l>
               <l>rnam par dkar ba'i bsod nam <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:6979">bdag</rs> gis ni ||</l> 
               <l>legs par skrun pa'i dge ba ci mchis pa ||</l> 
               <l>mtshungs med rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo ||</l></lg></seg></TEI>
